_note: Rent paid for one's own residence: "there shall be deducted any expenditure incurred by him towards payment of rent (by whatever name called) in respect of any furnished or unfurnished accommodation occupied by him for the purposes of his own residence" (s.134(1), p.170); "allowable on payment of such rent exceeding 10% of his total income, subject to a maximum of ₹ 5000 per month, or 25% of total income for tax year, whichever is less" (s.134(2)); the total income is "before allowing deduction for any expenditure under this section" (s.134(5)) — TOTAL_INCOME is gross total income less the other Chapter VIII deductions, held within it, unrounded; MONTH counts the months of stay the declaration states (OQ-22). The s.134(4) bars — a home owned by the assessee, spouse, minor child or HUF at the place; an occupied home owned elsewhere valued under s.21(6) or (7)(a); any income falling in Schedule III Table Sl. 11 (HRA) — are checked by the node. s.134(3)'s prescribed conditions: Income-tax Rules, 2026 r.65 (p.1581), "the assessee shall file declaration in Form No. 31" (pp.1913–1914) — no area limit is prescribed; the Rules' amendment chain after G.S.R. 198(E) is not traced (rulebook S6). Old regime only: s.202(2)(a)(xii) excludes Chapter VIII other than ss.124(1), 124(2), 125(2) and 146 (p.227). TY 2026-27 only; the 1961 counterpart, s.80GG with Rules 1962 r.11B, is unread (W-075d). rulebook DED-80GG-001, -002. D-141.
